newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Power failure prevents Philippine stocks trading.
newsitem.headline: Power failure prevents Philippine stocks trading.

text.p: Trading at the Philippine Stock Exchange was suspended indefinitely due to a power failure, bourse officials said on Monday.
"There's a total power failure in our Tektite floor," an official said.
The Philippine Stock Exchange operates two floors, one in the Tektite building in Ortigas centre and another in Ayala Tower in Manila's Makati business district.
"We are doing everything we can to restore power. The Tektite floor is already being powered by our generator," another official said.
Bourse officials said trading would resume once all the trading terminals were rebooted.
"It will be just a matter of minutes," he said.
The Philippine composite index closed 17.11 points higher on Friday at 2,944.48.
